name: Isekano
source:
"Roll your eyes all you want, this is about to change your life!"

Your little sister, Sara, claims that it is time for you to get a girlfirend.

She signs you up for Isekano, the latest trending dating app.

Match found! Before you know it, you're on your way to the first date.

Your date: A shy, beautiful girl named Kaida, who is a foreign exchange student. Will you show her around town?

Enjoy this first ever augmented reality visual novel!

[From [url=https://isekano.com/]The Official Site[/url]]
